row.body: foundation/regulator added: ran 13 unit tests, they pass; probed on this repo (226 python files indexed, second index run re-parsed 0). A relative-import and a from-package-import miss in the first draft made impact selection return too few tests; both fixed and covered by tests. Efficiency gain is a hypothesis, not measured: threshold is a 15 percent cut in tokens per resolved task on a 30-task replay set, otherwise the map injection is removed.
